source: manual placeholder , populated during the tournament by scripts/fetch-results.mjs
_format: matches keyed by match index (the data-mi on each fixture, 0-103). Per match: h/a = resolved 3-letter team codes for a knockout slot (optional); hs/as = home/away score (optional); status = FT | HT | LIVE (optional). Example: { "72": { "h": "NOR", "a": "BRA", "hs": 2, "as": 1, "status": "FT" } }
